component.name: Button
component.description: Triggers an action. Use a link for navigation.

usage.requiredPropsNote: Either visible children, or an aria-label when there are no children (enforced by the ButtonProps union type).

commonPatterns.name: primary-action
commonPatterns.description: The single main call-to-action in a view.

commonPatterns.name: secondary-action
commonPatterns.description: Alternative or cancel action next to a primary button.

commonPatterns.name: form-submit
commonPatterns.description: Submits a form. type defaults to "button", so submit must be explicit.

commonPatterns.name: async-submit
commonPatterns.description: Shows a spinner and ignores clicks while a request is pending. Stays focusable.

commonPatterns.name: destructive-action
commonPatterns.description: Irreversible action, typically inside a confirmation step.

commonPatterns.name: with-icon
commonPatterns.description: Label plus a decorative icon. Icons are aria-hidden, so the text carries the meaning.

commonPatterns.name: icon-only
commonPatterns.description: Compact button with no visible text. aria-label is required.

commonPatterns.name: full-width
commonPatterns.description: Fills its container, e.g. in a narrow card or on mobile.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Button for navigation to another page or route
antiPatterns.reason: A button has no href, so it breaks open-in-new-tab, middle-click and link semantics for assistive tech.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use an anchor or the router's Link component, styled as needed.

antiPatterns.reason: No accessible name. TypeScript rejects it via the IconOnlyButton type.
antiPatterns.alternative: Add aria-label, or add visible text as children.

antiPatterns.scenario: Multiple variant="primary" buttons in one view
antiPatterns.reason: Dilutes the visual hierarchy so the main action is no longer obvious.
antiPatterns.alternative: One primary; use secondary or ghost for the rest.

antiPatterns.reason: Red signals data loss or irreversible effects; misuse trains users to ignore it.
Icons are rendered aria-hidden, so screen readers will not announce them.
antiPatterns.alternative: Put the meaning in the text label.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using disabled to show a pending request
antiPatterns.reason: A disabled button drops out of the tab order and loses focus; users lose their place.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use loading, which sets aria-busy and aria-disabled and keeps focus.

antiPatterns.scenario: Relying on the default type inside a form to submit
antiPatterns.reason: type defaults to "button", so the form will not submit.

antiPatterns.scenario: Wrapping children in nested interactive elements (links, other buttons)
antiPatterns.reason: Invalid HTML and unpredictable keyboard behavior.
antiPatterns.alternative: Keep children to text and inline content.

slots.children: Visible label. Wrapped in a span; omit for icon-only.
slots.leftIcon: Decorative ReactNode before the label. Hidden while loading.
slots.rightIcon: Decorative ReactNode after the label. Hidden while loading.

composition.notes: Flat component: no compound subcomponents (no Button.Text or Button.Icon). Forwards ref to the underlying <button>.

interactions.click: Calls onClick. While loading, the click is prevented and onClick is not called.
interactions.loading: Spinner replaces both icons; aria-busy and aria-disabled set; button remains focusable.
interactions.disabled: Native disabled attribute; not focusable, no events.

responsive.fullWidth: Use fullWidth to stretch on narrow containers; otherwise sizes to content.

accessibility.screenReader: Announced by its text; icon-only requires aria-label; loading exposes aria-busy.
accessibility.focusManagement: Focus ring on :focus-visible; focus is retained during loading.

aiHints.context: Use for any user-triggered action in the UI. Choose variant by emphasis: primary (main), secondary (alternative), ghost (low emphasis), danger (destructive). Never use for navigation.
